args.lesson: Confirmed first that row location was still manual: transform.py reports only 'style X: same image URL used twice' with no rows. Built a stdlib helper (locate_dup_images.py) that gives each duplicate's record number, transform_line (record+1), physical lines and field values. It flags cross-style reuse as information only, lists blanks, and exits 2 on missing columns, malformed quotes or wrong field counts. TASK-179432676113: 12/12 synthetic checks, including multiline, leading-zero, BOM/CRLF and a cross-check against the unchanged transform.py. Found a limit: transform.py's 'line N' is the record number plus 1, so it is wrong for multiline records; this is documented and transform.py was not changed. What failed: one EXEC died because the output parent directory did not exist. Always mkdir before writing every output. Human time saved is unmeasured. No demand, customer or revenue. The public page is unchanged; any later claim of automated row location there needs a reviewed digest.
